meta.name: Average Bay Area single-story home
meta.notes: Origin = front-door threshold on the floor. +Y up, +Z into the house, +X toward the garage side (on your LEFT when standing outside facing the front door, since Three.js is right-handed). Room rectangles are wall-centreline dimensions; floor_area_m2 counts conditioned rooms only.
meta.style_basis: Typical 1950s-60s Bay Area single-story ranch (3 bed / 2 bath, ~1,700 sq ft) furnished for a family of four. Furniture uses standard US catalogue dimensions; kitchen follows NKBA clearances; 3-cart curbside waste (landfill/recycling/compost) and an EV in the garage.

doors.note: 6 ft sliding glass door; the 'start' half is the fixed pane

props.location: beside the closet, by the door (moved out of the closet so the laundry robot can reach it)
primary bedroom by the closet wall (moved out of the walk-in closet so the laundry robot can reach it)

two_story_variant.notes: Applied by index.html when meta.two_story is true. Items replace same-id entries or are added. Bedrooms 2 and 3 and the hall bath move to floor 1; the vacated ground rooms become a den (with the stair), an office and a storage closet.
